Subject: Mitacs Globalink Research Internship 2026 – Applications Open (Canada) – URGENT: Plaksha portal closes Jan 31

Hi Team,

Just a quick note — the Mitacs Globalink Research Internship programme for Summer 2026 is now open and our institutional window closes sooner than the main Mitacs deadline. Please circulate widely to eligible students.

WHAT IS MITACS GLOBALINK?
Mitacs is a Canadian national research organisation that funds 12-week research internships at Canadian universities. Selected students work under a Canadian faculty supervisor from July–September 2026 and receive a CAD 6,000 fellowship to cover living and travel expenses. Past Plaksha interns have been placed at UBC, University of Toronto, McGill, and Waterloo.

PROGRAMME DATES: July 7 – September 26, 2026
FELLOWSHIP: CAD 6,000 (covers travel to/from Canada + accommodation + living)
NO TUITION FEES.
SEATS: No hard cap — Mitacs accepts applications directly from students, but Plaksha's institutional endorsement significantly improves acceptance rates. We typically see 4–6 acceptances per cycle.

WHO CAN APPLY?
- Currently enrolled UG students who will NOT have graduated by the start of the programme.
- Minimum GPA: 3.0/4.0 scale OR equivalent (CGPA approx 7.5/10)
- Available for the full 12-week duration (no part-time or shortened placements)
- Strong research interest in STEM, business, or social innovation fields
- Must be a citizen or permanent resident of India (Mitacs bilateral agreement)

DEADLINE
Mitacs main portal: February 28, 2026
Plaksha internal endorsement letter: January 31, 2026

The internal endorsement requires sign-off from the Office of Academic Affairs (confirming good academic standing and no backlogs) and from OGE. Students who submit their Plaksha endorsement packet late will NOT receive the institutional endorsement letter in time.

STUDENT DOCUMENTS (to be submitted to OGE by Jan 31):
- CV
- Research statement (why this programme, preferred research areas, 600 words)
- Latest transcript
- Two reference letters from Plaksha faculty (to be sent directly by faculty to internship@plaksha.edu.in)

Please note: Mitacs runs an AI-matching algorithm between student research interests and Canadian faculty project listings. Students should identify 3–5 preferred project areas on the Mitacs portal.

For OGE internal use: the endorsement letter must be co-signed by OGE head and the relevant Program Chair or Department Head confirming the student's coursework alignment with their proposed research area.

Any questions, reach out to oge@plaksha.edu.in

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Senior Coordinator, Outward Mobility
Office of Global Engagement
